title: Prompt Engineer
description: A roadmap for designing, testing, and evaluating prompts for LLM applications with structured outputs, tool use, safety, and measurable quality.

tree.name: LLM and Prompting Foundations
tree.description: Understand how LLMs respond to instructions, context, examples, constraints, and ambiguity.

children.name: Instruction, Context, and Examples
children.description: Write clear tasks, define audience and tone, provide examples, constrain outputs, and reduce ambiguity.

children.name: LLM Limits and Failure Modes
children.description: Recognize hallucinations, stale knowledge, prompt injection, context limits, hidden assumptions, and overconfident answers.

tree.name: Prompt Patterns and Structured Outputs
tree.description: Design repeatable prompt patterns for classification, extraction, generation, summarization, reasoning, and JSON outputs.

children.name: Extraction and Classification
children.description: Extract fields, classify tickets, route requests, validate outputs, and handle uncertain or missing information.

children.name: Multi-step Reasoning and Tools
children.description: Break tasks into steps, call tools, use retrieval, ask clarifying questions, and verify intermediate results.

children.name: Practice: Prompt Regression Set
children.description: Create test prompts, expected outputs, edge cases, scoring notes, and compare two prompt versions.

tree.name: Evaluation and Safety
tree.description: Measure prompt quality through test sets, rubrics, regression checks, safety cases, and user feedback.

children.name: Prompt Evaluation Sets
children.description: Create golden examples, edge cases, adversarial prompts, scoring rubrics, and comparison reports.

children.name: Safety, Privacy, and Guardrails
children.description: Handle sensitive data, refusals, jailbreaks, prompt injection, output filters, and human review paths.

tree.name: Prompt Ops and Portfolio
tree.description: Version prompts, document decisions, monitor failures, and build a portfolio that shows measurable improvement.

children.name: Prompt Versioning and Monitoring
children.description: Track prompt versions, model changes, evaluation scores, user feedback, cost, latency, and failure patterns.

children.name: Project: Support Prompt System
children.description: Design prompts for ticket triage, answer drafting, escalation, JSON output, eval sets, safety checks, and a quality report.
